claim: Foot Locker New Zealand, Inc (NZ overseas co. 1218502, registered 27-Jun-2002) gave Gazette notice dated 30-Oct-2025 (published 10-Nov-2025), seven weeks after the DKS close, that it intended to cease carrying on business in NZ. It was removed from the NZ register on 19-Mar-2026. Foot Locker Services, LLC (8758906) filed a matching notice (2025-cb6434). NZ trading continues through Foot Locker New Zealand Holdings, LLC (co. 8848809, registered 4-Aug-2023), which is now named on the footlocker.co.nz Terms. On that entity, US FL executives Michael Baughn and Franklin Bracken ceased as directors on 8-Sep-2025 (the closing day), and Brisbane-based Natalie Ellis (FL VP APAC per the 2023 Investor Day) was appointed the same day. Bronwen Holford (APAC CFO) was appointed on 14-Jan-2026.
data_point: 1218502 status Removed; Registered 27-Jun-2002 to 19-Mar-2026; 8848809 directors: Cipriano (04-Aug-2023), Ellis (08-Sep-2025), Holford (14-Jan-2026); former: Baughn (06-Sep-2023 to 08-Sep-2025), Bracken (04-Aug-2023 to 08-Sep-2025)
source_name: New Zealand Gazette 2025-cb6433 / 2025-cb6434; NZ Companies Office records 1218502 and 8848809
original_quote: after the expiration of three months from the date of this notice, the company intends to cease to carry on business in New Zealand ... GIOVANNA CIPRIANO, Director
verifier_note: Gazette notice fetched live 2026-10-07 (text, dates and signatory match). Companies Office pages fetched live: 1218502 'Removed', registered 27 Jun 2002 to 19 Mar 2026; 8848809 director list matches exactly. The FL NZ Terms page names FL NZ Holdings, LLC (NZBN 9429051515027). Caveat: per the NZ Inc FY23 accounts, the business moved to the Holdings LLC on 31-Aug-2024, before the deal. The removal is the end of a pre-planned common-control reorganisation, not a market exit. The new fact after the deal is the director change on closing day.

claim: FL New Zealand, Inc's audited consolidated accounts for the 53 weeks to 3-Feb-2024 (KPMG Wellington, signed 16-May-2025; filed 30-May-2025) show: revenue NZ$61.08m vs 61.72m; gross margin 32.0% vs 39.5%; operating result -NZ$0.08m vs +NZ$6.28m; net loss NZ$0.38m vs profit NZ$4.11m. Royalties to the parent (NZ$1.68m) and management fees to FL affiliates (NZ$5.37m) total about 11.5% of sales. All lease liabilities mature between Jun-2025 and Sep-2029. The business moved to FL NZ Holdings, LLC on 31-Aug-2024 at book value, and the accounts were prepared on a non-going-concern basis because management intends to wind up the Inc.

original_quote: The consolidated financial statements have been prepared on a basis other than a going concern basis ... the assets, liabilities and business of the Company were transferred to its subsidiary, in a common control transaction at book value

Auditor report dated Wellington 16 May 2025. These are pre-deal accounts; NZ is small (about NZ$61m, roughly US$37m).

Seven pages show 'closed' every day, and two NZ pages show Friday-only hours. Landlord directories confirm FL is absent at five centres whose pages are still on the locator: Westfield Bondi Junction (296-store directory, no FL), Westfield Doncaster (388, no FL), Australia Fair (Shop G159 re-let to Diverse Living; the FL store page returns 404), Westfield St Lukes NZ (138, no FL) and Glenfield Mall NZ (no FL). Control centres (about 23 Westfields) correctly showed FL.

Locator stores with no seasonal ad: Bondi Junction, Castle Towers, Australia Fair (Southport), Doncaster, Chadstone B047 (all dark on the locator); Central Park, Broadway, Narellan, Dandenong Plaza and Bourke St Mall (normal hours, so at risk); NZ: Botany, St Lukes, Glenfield. That implies about 88 ANZ doors trading at Christmas vs 92 APAC ex-atmos at 8/1/26, and NZ at 11 of 14 locator stores.
